changelog:
- Added podcast episode and recurring show support, with new routing for podcasts.
- Refined routing logic: now locks medium first (long narration, multilingual, or brand clone) before directing requests.
- Updated documentation for required consent and clarified prohibition on unauthorized voice imitation.
- Removed obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Minor refinements to workflows and clarified supported routes and edge case handling.
summary: Use Voiceover & Narration Studio as an AI voice generator, text-to-speech workspace, and AI voiceover generator. Choose from the current voice library, turn scripts into ready-to-edit AI narration and voiceover, or create and reuse a custom brand voice through voice cloning. It supports short-video voiceover, script-to-voiceover, course narration, ordered audiobook narration, supplied multilingual text to speech, Cantonese text to speech, and recurring brand audio, with current price estimates, clear output planning, and delivery organized by chapter, language, and use case.
